warning.name: Immunosuppression
warning.text: No antibodies can be made next turn.

log.msg: MEMORY RESPONSE. Your body has met Leprosy before, so memory cells recognise it instantly. Destroying it costs just 1 Action Point and no antibody — the fast secondary response. This is why you only get chickenpox once — and it works only on Leprosy, not on other germs of the same type.

3 crowded spot(s) stopped growing — a single tissue space holds at most 8 bacteria. Real bacterial growth is density-limited. Note the cap is per SPOT, so the same disease can still build up on several spots at once.
B-Cell produced 1 ICB antibody (3/3). AFFINITY MATURATION — repeated practice against ICB has improved your antibodies. You now make one extra per action.
Memory antibodies coated Leprosy instantly — free.
Memory antibodies coated Chagas disease instantly — free.
Memory response destroyed Chagas disease — recognised and cleared at once. (1 AP)
